title: Utilise existing resources

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Reuse a shared visual resource when it fits so separate teams contribute to one recognizable city.
strategic_value: Existing indoor and outdoor event elements can support coherence without requiring each Helsinki team to start again.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture explains shared event resources and directs readers to employee and download sections.
practical_value: Check the existing resource pool before commissioning new event elements.

content_islands.name: Shared-resource guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the coherence rationale and the two resource destinations in one text block.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects consistent identity to coherent designs by multiple creators.
reference_purposes.Application: It directs designers to shared event resources and downloadable materials.
